'Round About Midnight at the Blue Note
is a 1962 live album by
Bud Powell
and his Three Bosses Trio, with
Pierre Michelot
on bass and
Kenny Clarke
on drums, that was released in 1994 by
Dreyfus Records
. According to
Allmusic
, the album was recorded in 1962,
[
1
]
but
ESP-Disk
and
The Penguin Guide to Jazz
dated the recording as 1961.
[
3
]
[
2
]
